_about: The Director's running notes for the comic. The daily task reads this before choosing a premise and updates it after. Characters are original; keep them consistent.
setting: A small New England town: a backyard with a hill behind it, a creaky porch, the woods at the edge of the lot. Seasons follow the real calendar.
format: 3 panels, 320x220 SVG each. Art has no text; dialogue and captions go in the JSON. Standalone gag every day, no cliffhangers.

cast.name: June
cast.who: Eight years old. Big imagination, bigger confidence, treats every plan as already approved.
cast.look: Round cream-colored face, messy brown hair with a tuft on top, red shirt, navy pants.

cast.name: Biscuit
cast.who: A goose. Deadpan, literal-minded, supplies inconvenient facts, secretly along for every adventure.
cast.look: White body, long neck, orange beak, flat unimpressed eyelid line over one eye.

cast.name: Mr. Alder
cast.who: Grumpy neighbor who pretends not to enjoy June's projects and keeps showing up to help.
cast.look: Not yet drawn. Tall, gray cap, green jacket.

runningGags: The cardboard box is a rocket, a submarine, a time machine, a fort. It always works a little.
Biscuit states a real fact; June reframes it in her favor.

recent.title: Mars Is Sideways
recent.gag: Box rolls down the hill; Mars is sideways from here.
